findings.text: scope: imas_ink/figures.py was written although it was outside the node's dispatched FENCE-SCOPE (which named only imas_ink/mpl.py, tests/unit/test_trace_resolution.py and the fragment/figure paths). Plan section 2 explicitly requires time_trace_figure_mpl and radial_profile_figure_mpl to pass label_x=False, and those builders live only in figures.py, so the scope list was the defect; the node reported it and the coordinator widened scope (status-repair.json). Recorded so the dispatch metadata, not the change, is corrected.

item_verdicts.call_sites: read all call sites of the two private renderers at the reviewed head: imas_ink/mpl.py:102 and :104 (render_mpl dispatch, no label_x -> default True preserves the public path), imas_ink/figures.py:97,100,102,146 (the two stacked builders). The later-series call at :100 passes label_axes=False, which returns before set_xlabel (imas_ink/mpl.py:574-580), so a multi-series non-bottom panel is not re-labelled; the new keyword is additive and backward compatible.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; a single commit e6ec372 (+81/-10) carries the two renderer keywords, the two builder call-site changes, three tests and the evidence fragment; the private-renderer call sites replace prior render_mpl dispatch, which is pure type dispatch (imas_ink/mpl.py:50) so nothing is lost, and no other matplotlib code path is touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: tests/unit/test_trace_resolution.py:64 builds a three-panel trace figure asserting ['', '', 'Time [s]'], :71 builds a three-panel radial-profile figure asserting ['', '', 'psi_norm'], and :79 draws a single TimeSeries through render_mpl asserting 'Time [s]'; all three pass here against the reviewed head (6 passed in tests/unit/test_trace_resolution.py), and the declared mutation (trace builder label_x=True for every panel) reddens exactly test_stacked_trace_labels_only_bottom_panel.
item_verdicts.goal: the landed change labels a stacked matplotlib figure's shared x-axis once: imas_ink/mpl.py:555 gives _render_timeseries_mpl a private label_x keyword (default True) and imas_ink/mpl.py:591 gives _render_radialprofile_mpl the same, imas_ink/figures.py:94-102 and :146 call the private renderers directly passing label_x=False for every panel but the bottom, and render_mpl (imas_ink/mpl.py:50) gains no keyword. Independently read at the reviewed head and reproduced.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete (repaired from blocked), base/after suite JSON both completed with identical 5 failure ids, negative control named with its log and reproduced here, and the ruff base=57/head=56 discrepancy recorded in evidence_inputs rather than hidden.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares four changed paths (imas_ink/mpl.py, imas_ink/figures.py, tests/unit/test_trace_resolution.py, docs/evidence/fragments/trace-figure-display-resolution/ink-trace-shared-xlabel.html); git show --stat over e6ec372 lists exactly those four. imas_ink/figures.py, however, was NOT in the node's dispatched FENCE-SCOPE, which named only imas_ink/mpl.py, the test file and the fragment/figure paths; the coordinator widened scope after the fact (status-repair.json, 2026-10-06T13:34:26Z).

justifications.durability: each added assertion fails under a specific regression and two were shown to: test_stacked_trace_labels_only_bottom_panel reddens when the trace builder labels every panel (shown, EXIT=1) and test_stacked_radial_profile_labels_only_bottom_panel reddens when the radial builder does (shown under the same mutation), while test_single_series_through_render_mpl_keeps_x_label guards the public path should label_x default ever flip.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed run's own gate logs agree and reproduce here: logs/base-suite.log and logs/after-suite.log both end '1 failed, 408/405 passed, 4 errors' with identical failure/error ids (all five in tests/unit/three_d/test_scene_cutaway.py); ruff-base.log 'Found 57 errors' vs ruff-after.log 'Found 56 errors' (adds none); the declared mutation reddens only test_stacked_trace_labels_only_bottom_panel here (EXIT=1). Minor: the dispatch fence declared ruff base 55, measured 57, and the node recorded that discrepancy in evidence_inputs; the change still adds no finding.
justifications.fit: label_x extends the renderer's existing private label_axes suppression idiom (imas_ink/mpl.py:555,580,591,603) with a mechanism docstring, the builders pass it at the call site, the fragment's ids are node-prefixed (id=ink-trace-shared-xlabel), and no plan label, version, ticket or author attribution appears in any changed path.
justifications.goal_fidelity: independently reproduced against the reviewed head (extracted tree e6ec372, module.__file__ = .../ink-head-review/imas_ink/__init__.py): both private renderers gate only ax.set_xlabel on label_x, both stacked builders pass label_x=False for every panel but the bottom by calling the private renderer directly, and render_mpl exposes no new keyword, exactly as plan section 2 directs.
justifications.reuse: a capability search over imas_ink for shared-axis label suppression (sharex, set_xlabel, label_axes, ticklabel, labelbottom) found no pre-existing label_x owner and only the altair stack in imas_ink/server/mcp.py:345 setting its own xlabel, which plan section 2 leaves unchanged; the change reuses the label_axes mechanism rather than forking a second suppressor.
justifications.scope_discipline: markdown: the diff touches imas_ink/figures.py, which the node's dispatched FENCE-SCOPE (imas_ink/mpl.py, tests/unit/test_trace_resolution.py, the fragment and figure paths) did not include; the change is entirely within what plan section 2 requires, and the node surfaced the mismatch via NEEDS-HELP rather than hiding it, after which the coordinator widened the declared scope (status-repair.json). The write was not mechanically refused. Scored down for exceeding the dispatched grant, not for the substance.
